product_metadata.title: PURPLE LADYBUG 7 Brown Gift Bags Medium Size with Handles & Scratch Panel for Personalized Messages - Unique Fathers Day Gift Bag Bulk, Graduation Gift Bag - Bachelorette Gift Bags with Tissue Paper
features: Make wrapping easy and fun! 7 Brown Kraft Paper Gift Bags have a scratch paper panel with rainbow drop pattern under the black matte surface -- it allows you to scratch a personalized message onto each of the small gift bags. So amazingly cool and fun!

Never worry about a lost card again! 7 Brown Kraft Paper gift bags with handles for easy carrying also come with 4 stylus-style scratchers to scratch your message and 7 different colors of tissue paper!

USA Patent-pending! Ultra-unique kraft paper bags will make your gift stand out from the rest - never worry about a lost gift tag or card when you've written your message right on the bag as scratch art!
High quality gift bags! Sturdy paper bags with handles great for gift-giving, party favors, wedding gifts or stocking up so you're always ready with gift bags bulk!

Practical size and recyclable! These kraft bags with handles measure 5" deep x 8" wide x 10" bag height + 4" handle drop. The scratch paper comes covered in a protective film so it will not scratch until you are ready to use the bag.
